name: UPMC Health Plan Pittsburgh Half Marathon
summary: The Pittsburgh Half Marathon is part of the Pittsburgh Marathon weekend, held in early May. It uses much of the marathon course through a hilly city with many bridges. In 2022 the half followed the first 11 miles of the marathon, then split after the Birmingham Bridge and returned Downtown on 5th Avenue.
courseHighlights: Crossing Pittsburgh's rivers on city bridges
Birmingham Bridge, where the half and full courses split (2022 route)
Large crowds and local bands along the route

paceStrategy.summary: Wikipedia describes the Pittsburgh course as hilly, and the half shares much of the marathon route. We found no elevation figures, so run by effort on the hills and keep your pace easy early. Check the current map, because the route changes from year to year.

segments.advice: Start slightly slower than goal pace and avoid surging in the crowd.

segments.terrain: Hilly neighbourhood streets shared with the marathon
segments.advice: Run by effort on the climbs and keep your breathing steady.

segments.terrain: After the Birmingham Bridge, back Downtown (2022 route)
segments.advice: Use the final miles to push if you feel strong.

fuelingNotes: No aid-station positions were found on the pages we checked. Wikipedia notes that volunteers staff aid stations along the course; check the current race guide and carry your own gels.
tips: Train on hills, as Wikipedia describes the course as hilly
Check the current course map; the route can change slightly each year
Check road-closure notices from the City of Pittsburgh for race morning, as the Downtown closures start in the early hours
Plan for crowds; the half had about 13,000 entrants in 2012 according to Wikipedia

faq.question: Is the Pittsburgh Half Marathon hilly?
faq.answer: Yes. Wikipedia describes the Pittsburgh Marathon course as hilly, and the half follows much of the same route. We found no official elevation figures.

faq.question: Where does the Pittsburgh Half Marathon split from the marathon?
faq.answer: In the 2022 course announcement, the half followed the first 11 miles of the marathon and split after the Birmingham Bridge. Check the current map.

faq.question: When is the Pittsburgh Half Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is held on a Sunday in early May, as part of the Pittsburgh Marathon weekend.
